description:
Get one company's derived signals within your plan's window, newest first:
the REST API's GET /v1/companies/{slug}/signals.

Use it for one company's ownership changes, mass exits, insolvency
declarations and the like; across all companies use recent_signals. A name
is searched as in
company_history: several matches return {ambiguous: true, candidates},
none returns {error, suggested_companies}.

Returns JSON {company_slug, total, count, next_offset, signals:
[{event_id, signal_type, date, company_slug, company_name, province,
details}]}, with former_slugs for a merged company (every slug is read),
and plan_window or hidden_by_plan when your plan's window applied: relay
their notes. AEAT_DEBTOR: say the company was on the list published on
that date, never that the debt is outstanding. count 0 is not proof of
good health.

Read-only; one request per call. Needs the pro plan or higher
(CONSOLIDATION and PE_ENTRY: risk); key in the X-API-Key header
(https://bormeapi.com/account).

company.description: Company slug, e.g. vaz-metales-sl (from search_companies), or a name of at least 3 letters or digits, e.g. "Mercadona", searched case-insensitively as in company_history.
company.title: Company

date_from.description: Earliest signal date, inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2024-11-01. Optional; moved up to the start of your plan's window when earlier (plan_window says so).
date_from.title: Date From

date_to.description: Latest signal date, inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-10-31. Optional.
date_to.title: Date To

offset.description: Signals to skip, integer 0-10000 (default 0); pass the previous page's next_offset, e.g. 50.
offset.title: Offset

signal_types.description: Optional list; each one of INSOLVENCY_FILED, ACCORDION, MASS_EXIT, OWNERSHIP_CHANGE, DISTRESS_COMBO, PHOENIX, ADDRESS_CLUSTER, AEAT_DEBTOR, PUBLIC_CONTRACT_AWARD, and on the risk plan CONSOLIDATION and PE_ENTRY, e.g. ["OWNERSHIP_CHANGE", "MASS_EXIT"]; omit for all types your plan covers.
signal_types.title: Signal Types
